'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 2 Steven Lewis DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steven Lewis]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Rops Is Tops, or I Love Kevin Shannan Too Much To Play Monkey TIEs
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
